verification.scope: Surface difference behind the rearmost final foot versus t=0.8s, restricted to visited foot regions and excluding the initial rear-foot position. No calibrated soil or physical robot validation.

timing_note: Observed elapsed time, not an isolated benchmark; small validation jobs overlapped the run. Rendering and compression excluded.

source_provenance.note: Public packaging removes unused variables/flags and formats source; experiment hash identifies the original executed file.

limitations: Original coarse spherical-grain translational DEM; no grain angular dynamics or calibrated sand parameters.
Newton/Cosmos models not executed by this Metal solver; MuJoCo integrates original free-body robot dynamics on CPU.
